capabilities: View and edit notes as table, board, gallery, list, chart, calendar, timeline, or form
Compute formula, relation, and rollup properties from frontmatter and wikilinks
Filter, sort, group, and summarize records with per-view saved settings
Run button workflows that create, edit, link, and update notes
Embed database views in notes and export or copy data as CSV or Markdown
disambiguation: Not a connector to external databases; each database is an ordinary Markdown file in the vault, with records stored as notes and frontmatter.
extras: Runs entirely locally; the README states no vault content, metadata, formulas, or settings are sent to an external service. Can convert Obsidian .base files.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to view and bulk-edit many notes as a structured database with multiple layouts, computed fields, and form-based capture.

relations.evidence: Record templates | Markdown, Obsidian Templates, or Templater files
Internal links reuse the core Page preview plugin and honor your modifier-key settings

summary: Database views over Markdown notes: table, board, gallery, list, chart, calendar, timeline, and form, with formulas, rollups, filtering, and inline editing.
